rows.vgi.title: Current WNBA Teams

rows: CREATE TABLE wnba.current_teams(team_id BIGINT, team_abbreviation VARCHAR, team_city VARCHAR, team_name VARCHAR, first_season INTEGER, last_season INTEGER, seasons INTEGER, games INTEGER, wins INTEGER, losses INTEGER, win_percentage DECIMAL(4,3), playoff_appearances INTEGER, division_titles INTEGER, conference_titles INTEGER, league_titles INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(team_id));

rows.vgi.doc_llm: All-time WNBA franchise records. row_kind 'franchise' is one all-time summary per franchise, 'era' rows split it by city and nickname, and 'defunct' rows are folded franchises. Filter row_kind before aggregating.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Franchise summaries, name eras, and defunct franchises with all-time records and titles.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Franchises with the most league titles.", "sql": "SELECT team_city, team_name, start_year, league_titles FROM nba.wnba.franchise_history WHERE row_kind = 'franchise' ORDER BY league_titles DESC LIMIT 10"}]
rows.vgi.title: WNBA Franchise History

rows: CREATE TABLE wnba.franchise_history(team_id BIGINT, row_kind VARCHAR, team_city VARCHAR, team_name VARCHAR, start_year INTEGER, end_year INTEGER, seasons INTEGER, games INTEGER, wins INTEGER, losses INTEGER, win_percentage DECIMAL(4,3), playoff_appearances INTEGER, division_titles INTEGER, conference_titles INTEGER, league_titles INTEGER);
